paypal.brandon_step: ONE STEP FOR BRANDON: open PayPal → Profile (or paypal.me) and read your PayPal.Me handle, then tell Zane or set paypal_me_handle here. Until then the PayPal rail renders as a send-to-email instruction (email above) instead of a one-tap link. The handle is NEVER guessed.
paypal.link_format: https://www.paypal.me/<handle>/<amount> — VERIFIED from PayPal's own help (paypal.com FAQ3918): appending /<amount> pre-fills the amount; /<amount><CUR> sets currency.
